name: homebrew-tap
sub: One Homebrew tap for every Versatile release, written by the release itself.
heroLabel: homebrew-tap: Versatile tools through brew install. One Homebrew tap for every Versatile release, written by the release itself.

diagrams.why: A cask reaches a user through one linear chain, from a project's tag to brew install, so a pipeline shows it.
diagrams.label: How a cask reaches you. A project pushes a version tag. Its release workflow runs GoReleaser, which builds the archives, publishes the GitHub release and commits the cask with the archive URLs and SHA-256 checksums to Casks in this tap. brew install reads the cask, downloads the archive and checks its checksum.
